tools.name: get_salah_flow_facts
tools.description: Get the core facts about Salah Flow: what it costs, which devices it runs on, where to download it, its accessibility and privacy stance, and how to contact the team. Use this before answering any factual question about the product. Pass a topic for just that section; leave it out for the whole shee

tools.name: answer_salah_flow_question
tools.description: Look a question up in the Salah Flow FAQ and return the closest published question-and-answer pairs, verbatim. Returns the full FAQ when nothing matches. The answers are the site's own words — prefer them over paraphrasing.

tools.name: search_salah_flow_docs
tools.description: Search salahflow.com's pages and blog posts by keywords. Returns the best matches with a snippet each; read one in full with read_salah_flow_page.

tools.name: read_salah_flow_page
tools.description: Read one salahflow.com page or blog post as Markdown, with frontmatter (title, description, canonical URL, last-updated). Accepts a path ("/privacy", "/blog/<slug>") or a full URL.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_salah_flow_facts" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get the core facts about Salah Flow: what it costs, which devices it runs on, where to download it, its accessibility and privacy stance, and how to contact the…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_salah_flow_docs, read_salah_flow_page · Private data: get_salah_flow_facts · Public sink: read_salah_flow_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_salah_flow_docs, read_salah_flow_page · Private data: get_salah_flow_facts · Public sink: read_salah_flow_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
